annotatedSteps.description: Finding sec²θ and cosec²θ using trigonometric identities
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
tan θ = 1/√5 ⇒ cot θ = √5
sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ = 1 + 1/5 = 6/5
cosec²θ = 1 + cot²θ = 1 + 5 = 6
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct calculation of sec²θ and cosec²θ using standard identities.
